components.name: Text
components.description: Render inline or block body text with a semantic element, size/weight modifiers, and a color token.

components.name: Heading
components.description: Render a semantic h1-h6 heading styled via Text-style modifiers, decoupling heading level from visual size.

components.name: Icon
components.description: Render a Material icon glyph by name with configurable size, color, fill, and an optional screen-reader label.

components.name: Carousel
components.description: Compound slide carousel with an infinite-looping track, drag/wheel/keyboard navigation, and screen-reader announcements.

components.name: List
components.description: Render an ordered or unordered list of List.Item children with an optional bullet style and color.

components.name: Label
components.description: Render a form field label with optional required marker, bold/small styling, and a help tooltip.

components.name: Section
components.description: Semantic landmark wrapper that renders as a section, article, aside, or div.

components.name: HeadingWithIcon
components.description: Render a heading paired with a leading icon as one composed unit.

components.name: Truncate
components.description: Clamp long text to a maximum length with an optional expand/collapse toggle to reveal the rest.

components.name: Table
components.description: TanStack Table v8 wrapper supporting sorting, filtering, selection, pinning, expansion, reordering, and built-in pagination.

components.name: TextGroup
components.description: Render a label/value pair, stacked vertically or inline horizontally with a configurable label width.

components.name: Calendar
components.description: Lower-level always-visible inline calendar primitive for scheduling grids or custom date controls; use DateField for plain date inputs.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Render an animated loading indicator with a configurable size and color.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Render placeholder blocks that mimic loading content shape before real content is ready.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.description: Render a labeled progress bar reporting a 0-100 value with accessible aria-valuenow semantics.

components.name: Tag
components.description: Render a compact colored label, optionally closable and truncated with a hover popover for the full text.

components.name: StatusBadge
components.description: Render a colored status pill with an optional icon and filled/bordered visual variant.

components.name: StatusIndicator
components.description: Render a small decorative colored dot indicating a status (success, danger, warning, inactive), optionally positioned at a corner.

components.name: ClosingButton
components.description: Render an icon-only close (X) button used to dismiss modals, cards, or other dismissible surfaces.

components.name: Button
components.description: Render a clickable action button with visual type/color variants, optional icons, loading state, and full-width layout.

components.name: CardButton
components.description: Polymorphic interactive wrapper that turns a single Card into a clickable button or navigation link.

components.name: InfoButton
components.description: Render a small circular info-icon button, typically used to open supplementary help content.

components.name: FloatingButton
components.description: Render a floating action button positioned over content, with configurable axis, size, and placement.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.description: Group related buttons together with shared visual styling and single-selection tracking.

components.name: Collapse
components.description: Disclosure component with an optional title and a chevron toggle button that expands/collapses its content.

components.name: CollapseButton
components.description: Standalone, fully-controlled toggle button for expanding and collapsing external content.

components.name: VerticalSpacing
components.description: Apply consistent vertical gaps between stacked child elements.

components.name: Grid
components.description: Row/Col 12-column responsive grid layout primitives for arranging content, with breakpoint-aware width, gutter, and alignment props.

components.name: TopNav
components.description: Top navigation bar with flat links and mega-menu submenus that collapses into a mobile drawer below a breakpoint.

components.name: MobileNav
components.description: Full-screen drawer navigation for mobile viewports with drill-down levels for nested nav items.

components.name: Alert
components.description: Render an inline banner message communicating info, success, warning, or danger, with an optional dismiss button.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: Render a placeholder block (icon, heading, description, and actions) shown when there is no content to display.

components.name: ToastContainer
components.description: Mount ToastContainer once at the app root, then raise transient notifications from anywhere with sendNotification(alertProps, toastOptions). There is no Toast component — each toast body is an Alert, so the key props below are AlertProps.

components.name: Card
components.description: Render a bordered content surface composed from Card.Header, Card.Content, and Card.Notification sub-components.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Compound collapsible-content component with one or more Accordion.Item entries, supporting single or multiple expansion.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.description: Render a trail of navigational crumbs with automatic separators, a mobile back-link variant, and collapsing for long trails.

components.name: HashTrigger
components.description: Wrap content with an id so it can be located, optionally auto-scrolled to, and reported on when the URL hash matches it.

components.name: HorizontalStepper
components.description: Render a horizontal multi-step progress indicator with auto-numbered, selectable HorizontalStepper.Item steps.

components.name: Link
components.description: Render a styled navigational anchor with optional underline and leading/trailing icons; polymorphic for router link components.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Render a page-number list with prev/next arrows, a results count, and an optional page-size selector; collapses to a mobile modal picker.

components.name: TableOfContents
components.description: Navigational table of contents for long pages or multistep forms, composed from nestable TableOfContents.Item entries.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Compound tabbed-navigation component composed from Tabs.List, Tabs.Trigger, and Tabs.Content, supporting controlled and uncontrolled active tab.

components.name: TextField
components.description: Single-line text input with a label, optional icon, clear button, size variants, and validation helper text.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Multi-line text input extending TextField with an optional character-limit counter.

components.name: NumberField
components.description: Numeric input with min/max/step constraints, an optional suffix, and increment controls.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Render an on/off switch control with a label, size, color, and optional lock icon or loading state.

components.name: FeedbackText
components.description: Render hint, error, or valid feedback text below a form control, wired for aria-describedby association.

components.name: Search
components.description: TextField-based search field with an onSearch callback and optional button. Pass a `suggestions` array to turn it into an accessible combobox for typeahead / suggestions (onSuggestionSelect, loading, minQueryLength, renderSuggestion, footer, hideOnScroll).

components.name: Radio
components.description: Single radio input control, typically used within a ChoiceGroup for mutually-exclusive selection.

components.name: ChoiceGroup
components.description: Render a group of radio or checkbox items with a shared label, supporting a default or segmented visual variant.

components.name: FileUpload
components.description: Button-triggered multi-file upload control with validation, size limits, and per-file progress/loading states.

components.name: FileDropzone
components.description: Drag-and-drop file upload area with validation, size limits, and per-file feedback via Attachment rows.

components.name: Select
components.description: Searchable dropdown select supporting single or multi-select, async option loading, and clearable selection.

components.name: TimeField
components.description: Time input with a wheel or fixed-slot grid picker popover, 24-hour "HH:mm" value, and a native-picker fallback.

components.name: TimePicker
components.description: Lower-level always-visible time-picker primitive (scroll-wheel or fixed-slot grid); use TimeField for plain time inputs.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Single checkbox input control supporting a checked, unchecked, and indeterminate state.

components.name: Slider
components.description: Range-input slider control with min/max/step, value tooltip, and optional companion input slot.

components.name: DateField
components.description: Date input with a calendar popover supporting single, multiple, and range selection, manual text entry, and a native-picker fallback.

components.name: Filter
components.description: Compact pill-shaped trigger for refining result sets, rendering as a toggle, single- or multi-select dropdown, or custom panel.

components.name: DateTimeField
components.description: Combined date-and-time input with a calendar and time picker in one popover, supporting single or range selection.

components.name: InputGroup
components.description: Compose an input with prefix/suffix addon slots that visually merge into a single control.

components.name: Field
components.description: Low-level controlled/uncontrolled input or textarea primitive used to build higher-level form controls.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Show contextual help text anchored to a trigger element on hover, click, or focus.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Show a floating panel of content anchored to a trigger element, opened by click.

components.name: Dropdown
components.description: Render a floating menu of Dropdown.Item actions anchored to a trigger element.

components.name: Modal
components.description: Portalled dialog with focus trapping, backdrop, and scroll locking, composed from Modal.Trigger, Modal.Content, Modal.Header, Modal.Body, and Modal.Footer.

components.name: Separator
components.description: Render a horizontal or vertical divider line between content sections.

components.name: Print
components.description: Control print-only visibility and CSS page/column break behavior for its child element(s).

components.name: StretchContent
components.description: Stretch a single child element to fill its container horizontally, vertically, or both.

components.name: ScrollVisibility
components.description: Show or hide (with animation) its child based on scroll position past a configurable distance/direction.

components.name: ScrollFade
components.description: Wrap scrollable content with fade-edge overlays that appear when there is more content to scroll to.

components.name: Affix
components.description: Pin content to the viewport via sticky or fixed positioning, offset relative to the page header.

components.name: Attachment
components.description: Render a file row with name, size, an optional icon and progress bar, and a slot for download/delete actions.

components.name: Ellipsis
components.description: Detect and truncate overflowing single-line text, exposing the full text via a tooltip.

components.name: Timeline
components.description: Render a vertical sequence of events from Timeline.Item children (each composed with Timeline.Title and Timeline.Description), deriving past, current, and future item states from activeIndex.

components.name: OptionContent
components.description: Reusable, non-interactive content template that lays out a selection indicator, icon, label, and meta for dropdown/select option rows.

components.name: SideNav
components.description: Render a vertical side navigation menu with collapsible items and a mobile drawer toggle.

components.name: Footer
components.description: Composable page footer built from Footer.Side, Footer.Body/Footer.Section, and Footer.Bottom slots, with a mobile-collapsed layout.

components.name: Header
components.description: Composable site header built from Header.Logo, Header.Center, Header.Actions, and related sub-components, with mobile toggle support.

components.name: ShowAt
components.description: Render children only at or above the given breakpoint(s), unmounting them otherwise.

components.name: HideAt
components.description: Hide (unmount) children at or above the given breakpoint(s), rendering them otherwise.
